description: Ministry of Home Affairs - Order under the Holidays Act that the days of 15.01.2018 & 05.02.2018 as additional bank holidays
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued under the Holidays Act, No. 29 of 1971, declaring specific days as additional Bank Holidays. It is a statutory instrument and regulatory matter, falling squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves the implementation and modification of existing legislation. While it names a Minister (Wajira Abeywardena), this is only in his capacity as the authority issuing the legal order, and the content does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or constitute a government personnel change. The primary purpose is regulatory - declaring new public holidays under statutory authority.
